steps.content: The charm Lichen gave you erupts with blinding golden light, slamming straight into the ghost—
[Screen Shakes + White Flash]

The black coffin strikes the earth with a thunderous crash, sending dust spiraling into the air. The coffin ghost dissolves with its form unraveling into nothing. One by one, the red threads fall, crumbling to white ash before they settle.
When the air clears, only a single copper coin remains, lying still in the dust.

You pat yourself down: all the artifacts and talismans Lichen gave you have been destroyed in the battle. Even that terminal's screen is nothing but static now, truly reduced to a piece of scrap metal.
...Perhaps that's a mercy.
You step forward. The silence wraps around you, deep and watchful. Only the soft scrape of your shoes against the ground.
Now it's just us. Can we talk for real this time?
You bend down and pick up the copper coin.

I'm not here to speak for her. I didn't come to demand you return anyone. The opposite, actually, I came to the Void of Yin alone because I didn't want her meeting... the one you just took. That thing.
You rub the copper coin between your fingers. Its surface still feels cold against your fingertips, yet devoid of any presence.
Is it still resisting you?
I've never thought of you as an enemy. Every time I've walked this place, you've kept me from danger, steered me away from the dead, and made sure I never paid their price.
And of course, one of them... is <color=#fb9259>Lichen</color>.
That "Lichen" wandering the Void of Yin... is that what she's becoming? If she keeps walking this path?
That's why you tried so hard to pull that "Lichen" back. You don't want her to end up like that either... do you?
A familiar, crisp clink rings out. For the first time in a while, it lands face-up.
...I see.
Something's clearly wrong with her... A broken taboo?
She forced her way into the Void of Yin to find me. Didn't realize she was being corrupted by its power...
And if the two of them met, the one here and the one out there, that'd make things even worse, wouldn't it?
The copper coin lands face-up once again.
So my instinct was right. But now what...?
What is that phantom? Why does it exist beside Lichen?
You flip the coin again. It wheels through the air, turning end over end—
And lands on its edge.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's stopping you now? Did I break another rule? Is this not something I'm allowed to ask?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or... do you not know either?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then let me ask something else. What are these places—the Realm of Yang and the Void of Yin? Lichen called them "reality" and "dream," but it's more than that, isn't it? Everything I've seen in the Void... that is real too.
You keep tossing the copper coin, but every question meets the same silence. Every answer balanced on a blade, refusing to fall. A wall that will not yield.
But there is one question. One question buried beneath all the others. One question you cannot leave unanswered.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is there still time? Can I still bring her back? ...What else can I do?
This time, more than ever, you need it to land face-up. You need a sign, a simple yes.
You flip the copper coin. It shudders in the air, and then—
[Transition + White Flash + Dark Mist Effect Begins]
Its burnished gold surface flakes away, melting into a viscous liquid that drips down in eerie silence.
It hits the ground with a dull, final thud, charred beyond recognition. Face up or down? The question is meaningless now. It's just a lifeless object.
It seems Lichen wasn't entirely right. Even in the Void of Yin, not all questions can be answered.
The answer, it seems, is yours to find alone.
A cold, eerie black aura seeps from the coin's remains and drifts forward like smoke. You follow its trail, and there, at the far end of your vision, lies the black coffin.
The phantom that Lichen has been chasing rests within.
